name: Aurora
description:
Layered noise curtains, each drifting on its own clock, read around the center of the grid. Works on a 2D panel and fills a 3D cube by depth. Controls: speed, zoom, fold, twist and contrast.

This is a sample entry, showing what a contribution looks like: it is the Aurora effect that ships with MoonLight.
author: ewowi

name: Brainworms
description:
Vibes: Organic, slightly unsettling - **could be stroboscopic if you make it so, if that's bad for you don't do that**

Apply preset as per attached.

Works well on big screens but can be a resource hog, dial back intensity by adjusting damping settings if required,

Pallete recommnendation: Spectrum Script for increase audio response (see video) 

Music pairing: A cheeky bit of scottish techno - Perc if you're feeling sophisticated, Scott Brown if your not.
author: wompslab

name: Night Harbor
description:
A night harbor in six layers, each placed on part of the panel with a Region modifier: a slow sky, twinkling stars, a ringed moon, a rippling sea, a shimmering horizon and sparks over the water.

The regions are percentages, so it fits any 2D panel; it was made on 128x128. It also shows what a region buys: the moon's Rings costs about 2 ms in its small box, where full-screen it costs 60 ms. On an ESP32-S3 at 128x128 it runs at 20 fps.

Needs a MoonLight build with presets as state documents (after 6.0.0).
author: ewowi
